class.description: GameplayAccessibilityOption encapsulates a comprehensive suite of visual, UI/Theme, shader, motion/photosensitivity, audio/cymatic, and motor/cognitive accessibility settings. Beyond direct Godot Server/Scene application (`apply_to_scene`), this class bridges into the `GameplayStyle` cascade by overriding `collect_rules()`. When enabled, motor and cognitive assists (such as slowing enemy movement/charge speed or boosting player survivability) automatically synthesize `!important` `GameplayRule` declarations that outweigh standard `GameplayDifficulty` rules. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
